patch_description:
This rewrite keeps the efficient incremental triangle-area updates but improves search quality in two ways:

1. It uses adaptive low-tail merit weighting: broad low-area tails guide early exploration, while narrow tails focus late search on equalizing the true bottleneck constraints.
2. It applies a final signed-determinant epigraph SLSQP polish. Once annealing identifies a stable orientation cell, triangle areas become smooth signed determinant constraints, allowing direct maximization of the minimum area.

The search remains deterministic, keeps all points inside the simplex throughout, and gracefully falls back to the annealed result when SciPy is unavailable or polishing fails.
